# FLX-6203: a column has two sources across the contract and the bundle

**Family:** expression language (the 6000 band)

Every value has one source (EXPR-SPEC-2 §9). A `derive` together with a `generates` on the same column, two `generates` on one column, a `dependency`'s `to` column that another rule or dependency also determines, or a scenario mapping on a column that a rule determines are two sources, whatever their `when`s. Several `derive` rules on one column are one source.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-6203
```
